description: Get reference documentation for the Orderly Indexer API, a read-only source of historical and aggregated trading data: volume and fee metrics, account events, trades, and rankings. Omit both parameters for an overview with base URLs, categories, common errors, and usage tips; pass `category` to discover all endpoints in an area, or `endpoint` to fuzzy-match one endpoint and return its parameters, request/response schemas, and TypeScript example (category takes precedence if both are supplied). Bundled docs lookup only — no API call, credentials, or rate limits. Use for analytics, dashboards, account history, and leaderboards; for live trading operations use get_api_info, and for zero-auth market data use get_public_info_api_info.

category.description: Filter by category (e.g., 'trading_metrics', 'events::events_api', 'trades::trades_api', 'trading_metrics::volume_statistic') - use instead of endpoint to see all endpoints in a category

name: get_indexer_api_info
